record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.original_question: Do there exist regular ultrafilters that are λ^+-OK but not λ^+-good? Here λ^+-OK is the weakening of λ^+-good obtained by requiring multiplicative refinements only for monotone functions f:[λ]^{<ℵ0} → D such that f(u) depends only on the size of the finite set u.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.6 (Dow 1985 [3]). Do there exist regular ultrafilters which are λ+-OK but not λ+-good?
the definition of λ-OK is a weakening of λ+-good which requires multiplicative refinements ...

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let D be an ultrafilter on an infinite set I of cardinality λ. Recall:

(1) D is regular if there is a family {X_i : i < λ} ⊆ D such that every infinite subfamily has empty intersection.

(2) For an infinite cardinal μ, D is μ-good if every monotone function f : [μ]^{<ω} → D (where monotone means u ⊆ v implies f(v) ⊆ f(u)) admits a multiplicative refinement, i.e. a function g : [μ]^{<ω} → D such that g(u) ⊆ f(u) for all u, and g(u ∪ v) = g(u) ∩ g(v) for all finite u,v ⊆ μ.

(3) D is μ-OK if every monotone function f : [μ]^{<ω} → D that depends only on the cardinality of its argument (i.e. |u| = |v| implies f(u) = f(v)) admits a multiplicative refinement g : [μ]^{<ω} → D as above.

Clearly μ-good implies μ-OK. The question is: for an infinite cardinal λ, does there exist a regular ultrafilter (on some index set of size λ) which is λ^+-OK but not λ^+-good?
artifact.status_search_result: Malliaris and Shelah (2012/2013, "Constructing regular ultrafilters from a model-theoretic point of view") construct, assuming the existence of a measurable cardinal κ > ℵ₀, a regular ultrafilter on λ ≥ 2^κ which is flexible (hence OK in the relevant sense) but not good, and state that this addresses Dow's question. A fully ZFC construction at arbitrary λ matching the original λ^+-OK vs λ^+-good formulation does not appear to be established, so the problem is best regarded as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Constructing regular ultrafilters from a model-theoretic point of view (Malliaris–Shelah)
status_evidence.snippet: Assuming a measurable cardinal κ > ℵ₀, construct a regular ultrafilter on λ ≥ 2^κ which is flexible (thus ok) but not good, addressing Dow's problem of constructing ultrafilters which are α^+-OK and not α^+-good.
status_evidence.claim: Partial answer to Dow's OK-but-not-good problem under a large cardinal hypothesis.
